edition.title: মেঘ ও রৌদ্র
edition.description: গ্রামের মেয়ে গিরিবালা আর পড়ুয়া শশিভূষণ — বৃষ্টির দিনে শুরু হওয়া এক নীরব বন্ধুত্ব, যার ওপর মেঘ আর রৌদ্রের মতোই পালা করে নেমে আসে আলো আর ছায়া।

provenance.source_edition: Katha-Chatushtay (কথা-চতুষ্টয়), Calcutta: Sahitya-Jantra, printed by Jagneshwar Ghosh, published by Kalidas Chakravarti, 1301 BS (1894); sole author Rabindranath Tagore. Validated (level 4) Wikisource scan pages with recorded page revisions; conversion rules as recorded for the Galpa-Dashak packets, plus the কথা-চতুষ্টয় opening page (collection name, story title and decorative scan ornaments dropped; the first section heading kept); no page-end hyphens. Scan pages 86-134 (page 135 holds only the printer's imprint and page 136 is blank, so neither is story text); the closing marker সমাপ্ত। is dropped like সম্পূর্ণ।. The author's one footnote (scan page 101) is kept as a note block directly after its paragraph; the song continued over scan pages 130-131 is one verse block; centred sung lines are verse.
provenance.rights_note: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর died 1941; first published 1894. Term screen verdict for 2026: screen_pass.
